import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request

log_path = os.path.join(os.environ["TMPDIR"], "work-leaf-real-slash.log")
log = open(log_path, "w", encoding="utf-8")
proc = subprocess.Popen(
    ["cargo", "run", "--quiet", "--bin", "work-leaf", "--", "--daemon"],
    stdout=log,
    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
    text=True,
)
url = None

def http(method, path, body=None, timeout=20):
    data = None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode()
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        url + path,
        data=data,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        method=method,
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
        return json.loads(response.read().decode())

def cleanup():
    global url
    if url:
        try:
            http("POST", "/shutdown", {}, timeout=2)
        except Exception as error:
            print(f"cleanup shutdown failed: {error}")
    if proc.poll() is None:
        proc.terminate()
        try:
            proc.wait(timeout=5)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            proc.kill()
            proc.wait(timeout=5)
    log.close()

try:
    deadline = time.time() + 60
    while time.time() < deadline:
        log.flush()
        if proc.poll() is not None:
            print("work-leaf daemon exited before startup")
            print(open(log_path, encoding="utf-8").read())
            raise SystemExit(1)
        text = open(log_path, encoding="utf-8").read()
        for line in text.splitlines():
            if line.startswith("http api at: "):
                url = line.removeprefix("http api at: ").strip()
                break
        if url:
            break
        time.sleep(0.1)
    if not url:
        print("work-leaf daemon did not report an HTTP API URL")
        print(open(log_path, encoding="utf-8").read())
        raise SystemExit(1)

    def wait_idle(label, timeout=180):
        deadline = time.time() + timeout
        last = None
        while time.time() < deadline:
            state = http("GET", "/state")
            last = state
            if not state["busy"]:
                return state
            time.sleep(0.25)
        print(f"timed out waiting for {label}; last state:")
        print(json.dumps(last, indent=2))
        raise SystemExit(1)

    http("POST", "/command", {"line": "new Reply exactly WORK_LEAF_REAL_AGENT_READY and do not modify files."})
    state = wait_idle("real Codex agent launch")
    sessions = state["snapshot"]["sessions"]
    if not sessions:
        print("agent launch did not create a visible session")
        print(json.dumps(state, indent=2))
        raise SystemExit(1)

    agent_id = sessions[0]["id"]
    http("POST", "/agent/message", {"agent_id": agent_id, "message": "/status"})
    state = wait_idle("/status backend command")
    http("POST", "/agent/message", {"agent_id": agent_id, "message": "/fork"})
    state = wait_idle("/fork backend command")

    session = next(session for session in state["snapshot"]["sessions"] if session["id"] == agent_id)
    lines = session["lines"]
    checks = [
        any(line == "user: /status" for line in lines),
        any("OpenAI Codex app-server status" in line for line in lines),
        any(line == "user: /fork" for line in lines),
        any(line.startswith("Forked Codex thread ") for line in lines),
    ]

        print(json.dumps(session, indent=2))
        raise SystemExit(1)

    for line in lines:

            or "OpenAI Codex app-server status" in line
            or line == "user: /fork"
